Model-based iterative cleaning

Iteratively detect potentially erroneous pharmacokinetic observations

Iteratively detect and remove influential individuals

Calculate the pseudo-objective function value (pOFV) change across iterations

Dataset filtering

Plot metrics from the observation removal process
